description: For low-down-payment borrowers (LTV > 80%): projects when private mortgage insurance (PMI) drops off, the total PMI paid until then, and how much extra monthly principal cancels PMI sooner. Reuses the same amortization + PMI logic as estimate_monthly_cost. If no rate is supplied, the current best market rate for the state is used. Use for 'when does my PMI go away / how do I get rid of PMI faster?' questions.

extra_monthly_payment.description: Optional extra principal/month to model faster cancel. Default 0.

home_price.description: Purchase/appraised price. Required unless loan_amount given.

loan_amount.description: Optional explicit loan; overrides home_price - down_payment.

pmi_rate.description: Annual PMI as % of loan balance. Default 0.5.

rate.description: Annual rate %, e.g. 6.5. Omit -> best market rate for state.

state.description: 2-letter code for market-rate lookup. Default CA.

name: project_pmi_removal

assumed_defaults.description: Inputs the caller did not supply that were filled in with defaults. State these explicitly to the user, since they drive the numbers.

ltv_basis.description: LTV basis assumed, e.g. 'original_value' (purchase price) rather than a current appraisal.

pmi_rate.description: PMI rate assumed, as a percent string. Note this field carries a formatting quirk: it renders the annual PMI rate as a whole-number percent, so read it as the annual PMI rate and prefer monthly_pmi_initial for the actual dollar cost.

state.description: State code assumed for market-rate lookups because the caller did not supply one.

term_months.description: Loan term in months assumed because the caller did not supply one.

disclosures.description: Caveats and assumptions that must accompany any answer built from this result; surface them rather than dropping them.

down_payment.description: Cash in dollars put down at closing.

extra_needed.description: How much extra principal per month would be required to hit 80% LTV by various target dates.

extra_monthly.description: Extra principal in dollars per month required to hit that target — often far beyond what a borrower can sustain.

reach_80_in_months.description: Target number of months to reach 80% LTV.

home_price.description: Purchase price in dollars, as a formatted string.

monthly_pi.description: Monthly principal-and-interest payment in dollars, excluding PMI.

monthly_pmi_initial.description: Monthly PMI premium in dollars at the start, before the balance amortizes down.

next_actions.description: Suggested follow-up tools that would deepen this answer; offer them as next steps, not as results.

tool.description: Name of the follow-up MCP tool to call next.

why.description: One-line reason this follow-up tool would be useful given the current result.

pmi_applies.description: True when PMI is required at origination; false means the rest of this projection is moot.

pmi_drop.description: The two dates PMI can come off: the earlier one the borrower must request, the later one is automatic.

auto_terminate_78.description: When the balance reaches 78% LTV and the servicer must drop PMI automatically. Later, and more expensive, than requesting at 80%.

ltv_basis.description: What LTV is measured against: 'original_value' means the purchase price, so appreciation does not accelerate the drop unless the borrower pays for a new appraisal.

request_cancel_80.description: When the balance reaches 80% LTV — the borrower must actively request cancellation at this point; it does not happen on its own.

rate_source.description: Where rate_used came from: 'provided' means the caller supplied it, 'market' means it was resolved from the best live published rate for this state and product.

rate_used.description: Interest rate, in percent, used for every calculation in this result. Check rate_source to see whether it came from the caller or from live market data.

starting_ltv.description: Loan-to-value at origination as a percent string. PMI applies above 80%.

total_pmi_paid.description: Total PMI in dollars paid before it drops off, on the scheduled payments alone.

with_extra_payment.description: How the caller's extra monthly principal payment accelerates PMI removal.

extra_monthly.description: Extra principal in dollars paid each month in this scenario.

months_saved.description: Months earlier PMI drops off thanks to the extra payments.

new_drop_date.description: Calendar year-month when PMI now drops off.

new_drop_month.description: Payment number when PMI now drops off, counting from the first payment.

pmi_saved.description: PMI dollars avoided by paying down faster.
